title: I.R. Coelho (Dead) by LRs. v. State of Tamil Nadu

content.caseIdentity: I.R. Coelho (Dead) by LRs. v. State of Tamil Nadu, (2007) 2 SCC 1
content.facts: The Court examined Ninth Schedule immunity against judicial review.
questionsBeforeCourt: Whether constitutional insulation from review is unlimited.
Whether post-Kesavananda Ninth Schedule protection is unlimited.
content.ratioDecidendi: Post-Kesavananda Ninth Schedule laws remain reviewable on basic-structure grounds where fundamental rights forming part of that structure are damaged.
content.relevance: Use for constitutional review and rule-of-law limits.
